'''Star Tours Flight 908''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Garos IV]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight was on time and scheduled to depart from the spaceport's Gate 1J at 1720 hours.
